newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks drop along with Dow amid Fed caution.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks drop along with Dow amid Fed caution.

text.p: Mexican stocks were showing moderate losses during the midafternoon Thursday after retracing an earlier push into positive territory.
Stocks slipped amid light profit-taking triggered by a slide on Wall Street and caution ahead of the August 19 U.S. Federal Reserve policy-making meeting, dealers said.

"The market is quiet and volume slow because dealers are cautious over the Fed meeting, even though they've practically ruled out a rise in U.S. interest rates," a floor trader said. The leading IPC share index was down 15.65 points, or 0.32 percent, at 5,000.81.
